scene: Intro: the cover comes alive. A snowy street at night, warm windows; Pip the penguin waddles along a single trail of footprints while snow falls; "mbastein" and "With You" print into the snow.
Everyone on the street carries a little bit of warm light in their mittens; Stein, in a beanie and scarf, holds his up and Pip holds a tiny one too.
The map from No. 1 again: this time a dotted line runs back up the coast from SoCal to a snowy pin up north.
A mousetrap baited with a paper heart snaps shut; the camera dives into her eye, where Stein is reflected.
An alarm clock rattles on a frosted windowsill and Stein's eyes pop open in bed.
From the snowy street Stein looks through a warm window at the room they shared, one hand on the door.
A wall calendar flips day after day, every square getting a heart stamped on it.
Stein thumbs at himself in the snow, beanie crooked, one eyebrow up: okay.
Pip stands at a dark window as a calendar page turns to tomorrow and a question mark hangs in the frost.
Stein holds a wilted flower and a note that says sorry while a small snow cloud follows him.
Close on Stein's eyes, red-rimmed; his tears freeze into tiny icicles.
Stein flops flat into the snow with X eyes, a very dramatic snow angel; Pip pokes him with a flipper.
A cut-away of Stein's chest: inside, a tiny Stein shouts into a megaphone while the outside Stein says nothing.
The tiny Stein knocks on his ribs; the shout comes out muffled, a dotted bubble that never leaves.
Precious appears in a warm doorway in earmuffs, hiding something behind her back.
She reveals a jar of warm light and holds it out to him.
The jar's light jumps into a gold bulb over Stein's head.
A flat paper heart-monitor line kicks into a beat and Stein's heart jumps.
Callback to No. 1: the gold "give me life" prints across the page while flowers push up through the snow.
Stein spins Precious in the snow; flakes swirl and turn to gold sparks.
They look into a snow globe: inside, a little house with a lit window and smoke from the chimney; FUTURE stamp.
In the snow globe now: the two of them grey-haired on a porch swing, two penguins beside them; FUTURE stamp.
A blizzard: Stein and Pip shiver, teeth chattering, as a thermometer drops; COLD stamp.
Stein is frozen in a block of ice with only his eyes moving while Pip slides past on his belly; COLD stamp.
Stein flops onto a sofa by the fire under a blanket with cocoa, snow falling outside.
Both in pyjamas under a quilt with two pillows, a laptop movie glowing on their faces, popcorn between them.
She pulls the quilt over both their heads into a quilt tent; little hearts float out.
Yesterday's calendar page is torn off, crumpled and tossed into the fire, where it bursts into sparks.
Stein works a claw machine; the claw closes on a heart plush: yes, okay.
A heart-shaped boomerang flies out across the snow and comes right back to his hand.
Split-screen video call: Stein in the snow, Precious by a warm lamp, both waving.
Stein in sunglasses leans on a snowbank while ice cubes orbit his head.
Precious in sunglasses sleds downhill, scarf flying, way cooler.
Three wrapped gifts sit in the snow; her hand hovers, choosing.
She opens one and a pocket multitool unfolds: whisk, umbrella, spoon, a heart.
She picks the biggest box and Stein pops out of it.
Stein slowly cranks a jack-in-the-box: tick, tick, tick.
Pop: Stein springs out of the box and spring arrives with him; the snow melts to mint and flowers pop up everywhere.
Precious springs up beside him; they bounce together.
Thought bubbles pop above Stein: carrying her bags, flipping pancakes, holding an umbrella over her.
A high five, then the instrumental turns day into night: the sun sets, the moon rises, the streetlights come on.
Stein and Pip sit on a snowy rooftop under a big moon; NIGHT stamp.
Precious waves from a rooftop across the street, lit windows between them; NIGHT stamp.
A string of lights joins the two rooftops and Pip ziplines across it; NIGHT stamp.
Stars join into a ring-shaped constellation and the moon turns into the Ring from No. 1; NIGHT stamp.
A riso roller floods the sky with ink-black and the stars pop out one by one.
An ice cube drops into a glass with a clink and frost creeps up the glass; COLD stamp.
Precious holds out one of her earbuds; Stein takes it and music notes float up between them.
Stein nods along, a doodled "me too" beside him.
Callback to No. 1: two hands, the Ring on hers, one on his: I do.
Their fingertips almost meet in the dark and a spark jumps the gap.
All over the street, hands go up holding little lights, like the first scene.
A snowball hits Stein square in the face: splat, stars, a very loud doodle.

Epilogue over the instrumental: Pip meets another penguin under a streetlight and offers her a pebble; they waddle off together, leaving two sets of footprints; the camera tips up to the stars and the page folds shut on the foil end card.
